# async-batch-processor
> Sliding-window async pool with per-item retry, order preservation, and helpers

Sliding-window async pool. Keeps exactly N items in flight, preserves result order, supports per-item retry with exponential backoff, abort signaling, and progress callbacks. ```typescript import { AsyncBatchProcessor } from 'async-batch-processor';

## API
- `ProcessOptions`
- `AbortSignalLike`
- `ItemResult`
- `AsyncBatchProcessor`
